title: Prompt Architect Generator Plugin
description: Meta-schema for a generator plugin. A plugin is a pure data file (YAML or JSON) that teaches Prompt Architect how to build a one-shot prompt for one target generator: which fields to show, how to constrain them, and how to assemble their values into the generator's native prompt syntax. Plugins contain no code; updating a plugin never requires touching the application.

id.description: Stable machine identifier, kebab-case. Never changes once published; presets and history reference it.

name.description: Human-readable generator name shown in the UI, e.g. 'Midjourney'.

modality.description: Primary output medium of the target generator. Drives UI grouping and filtering. Plugins that declare modality 'image', 'video', '3d', 'audio', or 'world' are structured plugins: they must supply fields[], promptTemplate, and outputRules. A 'freeform' plugin type (planned, not yet a valid enum value) will allow lightweight metadata plugins for the Glyph Canvas mode — no fields[], no promptTemplate required. Until that meta-schema minor lands, Glyph Canvas operates schema-free.

version.description: Semantic version of THIS plugin file (not of the target generator). Bump patch for option updates, minor for new fields, major for breaking template changes.

targetVersion.description: Free-form note describing which release(s) of the target generator this plugin was authored against, e.g. 'Midjourney v7 parameter set'.

docsUrl.description: Link to the vendor's authoritative parameter documentation, used when re-verifying the plugin.

lastVerified.description: ISO date a human last checked this plugin against the vendor docs. Plugins older than 90 days are flagged stale by tooling.

fields.description: Ordered list of user-facing inputs. Order here is the form layout order; outputRules.parameterOrder controls prompt assembly order.

promptTemplate.description: Assembly template using token substitution. Syntax: '{{key}}' substitutes a field's formatted value ('' when unset). '{{#key}}...{{/key}}' is a conditional section emitted only when the field is set (non-empty, visible per dependsOn, and — when omitIfDefault is true — different from its default). Sections may contain tokens but do not nest. Example: '{{subject}} --ar {{aspect_ratio}}{{#seed}} --seed {{seed}}{{/seed}}'.

computedTokens.description: Declarative computed-flag rules. Each entry defines a virtual token (referenced as {{=id}} or {{#=id}}…{{/=id}} in the template) whose emitted string is chosen when a set of conditions holds. Use for generator-specific flag renames that plain token substitution cannot express — the canonical example is Midjourney's --niji flag, which is a separate parameter rather than a --v value and so cannot be expressed as a field option.

key.description: Token name used in promptTemplate, parameterOrder and dependsOn. snake_case, unique within the plugin.

description.description: Help text shown under the control. Explain what the parameter does in the TARGET generator's terms.

type.description: string = free text; number = numeric with range; boolean = toggle; enum = single choice from options; multi = multiple choices from options, joined with outputRules.listSeparator.

default.description: Initial value. For enum/multi it must reference option value(s); checked by scripts/validate.mjs.

multiline.description: string fields only: render a textarea instead of a single-line input.

options.description: Required for enum/multi fields; forbidden elsewhere.

omitIfDefault.description: When true, conditional sections keyed on this field are skipped if the current value equals the default. Use for flags the generator already assumes (e.g. Midjourney --chaos 0) to keep prompts minimal.

dependsOn.description: All conditions must hold for the field to be visible. Hidden fields are treated as unset by the template engine.

option.description: Either a bare string (value doubles as label) or an explicit value/label pair.

field.description: Key of another field in this plugin.

value.description: Comparison operand. Array for in/notIn, scalar otherwise, omitted for truthy.

computedToken.description: A virtual token whose emitted string is activated by a set of conditions. Referenced in promptTemplate as {{=id}} (scalar) or {{#=id}}…{{/=id}} (section). When no 'when' conditions are supplied the token is always active.

id.description: Token identifier. Used in the template as {{=id}}. Must be unique within computedTokens; must not collide with a field key.

emit.description: The literal string emitted when all 'when' conditions hold. Example: '--niji 6'.

description.description: Human-readable note explaining what this computed token does and why it is needed.

when.description: All conditions must hold for this token to be active. When absent or empty the token is unconditionally active.

outputRules.description: Post-processing contract applied after template rendering, plus the canonical parameter ordering that CI enforces against the template.

parameterOrder.description: Canonical ordering of ALL field keys. Single source of truth: scripts/validate.mjs asserts that the first occurrence of each token in promptTemplate respects this order, so template edits cannot silently reorder generator flags.

separator.description: String that runs of horizontal whitespace collapse to when collapseWhitespace is true. Newlines always survive (some targets, e.g. AUTOMATIC1111 paste format, are line-oriented).

maxLength.description: Hard or practical character cap of the target input (e.g. 2000 for Discord messages). Omit when the target has no meaningful cap.

overflowStrategy.description: What the renderer does when output exceeds maxLength.
